podcast.body: The B-side to Moby's 1992 single "I Feel It," this track reaches 1000 beats per minute (BPM) and is listed in the Guinness Book of World Records as the fastest dance song ever, though this is sometimes disputed by modern compositions exceeding 15,000 BPM that haven't been hit singles. "Thousand" reached number 38 on the British charts. "a song that reaches 1000 beats per minute."
